prompt:
Draw: A strigoi from Romanian folklore: a pale undead figure in a dark ragged cloak, side view facing left, standing.
Canvas: exactly 32x32 pixels per frame.
Palette: use only these 32 colors and transparent, no others: #B33831 #CD683D #FDCBB0 #E6904E #9E4539 #6E2727 #45293F #AE2334 #E83B3B #FB6B1D #F9C22B #FBFF86 #91DB69 #239063 #165A4C #0B5E65 #4D65B4 #4D9BE6 #30E1B9 #FFFFFF #C7DCD0 #9BABB2 #7F708A #323353 #3E3546 #2E222F #F04F78 #6B3E75 #A24B6F #F68181 #FCA790 #AB947A.
Background: transparent.
Safe area: draw the subject's body about the size of the central 26x26 pixels - rows 4-29 and columns 4-29, counting rows and columns from 1 - inside a 3-pixel margin on every side. That is a target for its average size, not a wall: when a pose or a detail needs the room (a raised weapon, a long blade, an effect, a wide stance), it may reach past the safe area into the margin, up to the canvas edge. Keep the four corner pixels transparent.
Floor: row 29, the bottom row of the safe area, is the ground: the feet (or the lowest point the subject rests on) stand on row 29.
Style: clean, readable pixel art for a 2D RPG: a dark (not pure black) outline around the silhouette, 2-3 shades per material, light from the top-left, no anti-aliasing noise and no stray single pixels.

Output format: exactly one fenced code block tagged `pixels`, and nothing after it:
```pixels
PALETTE
. transparent
a #RRGGBB
b #RRGGBB
...
FRAME <frame name>
<32 lines, each exactly 32 characters>
...
END
```
- Each palette line is one key character and one #RRGGBB color. Keys are single characters from a-z, A-Z, 0-9; `.` is always transparent and is never redefined.
- Each frame is exactly 32 lines of exactly 32 characters, every character a palette key, with no spaces.
- Frames in this order: sprite. Write `FRAME <name>` before each frame and `END` once after the last frame.
